title: Finalize a submitted order
objective: Confirm that finalizing a submitted order reaches FINALIZED state.
preconditions: A synthetic order exists in SUBMITTED state.

steps.action: From Orders, open Search and locate the submitted order.
Open the matching order and review its items.
steps.expected_result: The selected order details are displayed.
The order state changes to FINALIZED.

postconditions: The synthetic order is in FINALIZED state.
cleanup: Use an approved isolated test environment for the finalized order.
notes: Selected implementation evidence returns PROCESSING and therefore diverges from RF003.
